target_customer: Enterprises needing demand, energy, retail and workforce forecasts, plus researchers using open weights
problem: Forecasting usually requires per series feature engineering and model tuning; a pretrained time series foundation model aims to give calibrated forecasts with no fine tuning.
business_model: Usage-based API and web app on proprietary foundation models, with open weights releases
product_category: Time series foundation models and planning systems

founders.name: Joachim Fainberg
prior_employers: JPMorgan Machine Learning Center of Excellence
education: PhD in machine learning for speech (institution not listed)
founders.background_notes: ML and NLP team lead at Consigli; senior algorithm engineer at Vind AI.

competitors.name: Nixtla TimeGPT
competitors.what: Hosted API for zero shot time series forecasts

technical_complexity.rationale: Training a competitive pretrained forecasting model requires research skill and compute, which suits a founder pair with PhDs and forecasting research backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Large labs and startups released competing models almost monthly, and the company itself releases open weights, so the edge lies in model quality and product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Big labs released free competing models in 2024; no source shows an acquisition of the company.

market_need_then: Forecasting underpins supply chain and energy planning, and 2023 to 2024 saw a wave of foundation model attempts for time series; the company lists Engie, Netflix and Shake Shack as users on its site.

identity.voice_and_tone: Concise, confident and somewhat philosophical; cites Miyamoto Musashi's line 'There is timing in everything'.

branding.brand_signature: The 'Timing is at the heart of right action' tagline with open weights t0 model
branding.community_and_virality: Releases open weights t0 models on Hugging Face and a pip package, which is its own developer facing channel.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive generic name with no brand press found; the Musashi voice and open weights releases add some identity.

outcome_analysis: The company is active, ships an open weights forecasting model and lists known enterprise users, but funding beyond a small 2024 note is not publicly documented. It competes with Google, Amazon, Salesforce and Nixtla models that appeared at the same time, so its future depends on model quality and product delivery.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights shows about 500K, a convertible note dated 2024-08-28 with Y Combinator, Kima Ventures and No Label Ventures; VCBacked shows 500K pre-seed (2024-09); Dealroom shows 500K in text but 125K in a table. All aggregators, so no round recorded. Location listed as Paris by YC and Dealroom, San Francisco by VCBacked. Other time series models (TimesFM, Chronos, Moirai) launched through 2024, exact dates not found. Customer names are self reported on the site. Search found nothing about the name origin.
